newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BANKS' MARKKA LENDING ROSE IN APRIL-C.BANK.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BANKS' MARKKA LENDING ROSE IN APRIL-C.BANK.

text.p: Finnish banks lending to the public rose in April compared to March, and the stock of credits also grew a little, the Bank of Finland said in its monthly financial markets review received on Tuesday.
New credits in April totalled 12.1 billion markka compared to 8.1 billion in March and the stock of credits rose to 264.1 billion markka by end-April from 262.7 billion at end-March.
Markka lending to households rose to 4.2 billion markka in April from 3.1 billion in March and the stock of household credits rose to 151.9 billion from 151.8 billion at end-March.

The average interest rate on total new lending fell to 4.62 percent in April from 4.88 percent in March, and the average interest rate on entire markka credit stock to the public fell to 5.63 percent from 5.67 percent, the central bank said.
The average interest rate on new loans to households fell to 5.95 percent from 5.99 percent in April and the interest rate on the total stock nudged down to 6.28 percent from 6.31 percent.
